log.read.synthetic.json is HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded.

It continues plain/log.read.json (ids 1039+) with syslog lines the DL-WRX36
test router had not produced when the fixture was recorded: WAN up/down (WAN
unplugged), hostapd station events (no WiFi client yet), DHCPACK/RELEASE for a
phone, failed ssh/LuCI logins, password/pubkey ssh logins.

Message formats come from the router's own binaries (strings /usr/sbin/hostapd,
/usr/sbin/dropbear; /usr/share/ucode/luci/dispatcher.uc) and netifd/dnsmasq
lines already seen in the real log. Priorities are facility*8+severity as logd
reports them (daemon.notice 29, daemon.info 30, authpriv.warn 84, ...).
MACs 3a:7c:12:9e:44:01 and 9e:12:aa:30:5b:77 are invented.

Replace with a real recording once the router has seen these events.
